title: Append-only project update
description: One row of data/project-updates.csv. Records the City's reported position at a point in time. Rows are never edited or deleted after review; corrections get a new row.

reported_at.description: Date of the meeting or document that reports this position, ISO 8601.

reported_budget_usd.description: US dollars, no symbols or separators. Empty means NOT REPORTED, never zero.

reported_budget_label.description: City wording when the source does not give a single number.

reported_completion.description: Latest forecast or actual, ISO 8601, year or month precision allowed.

change_reason.description: The city's stated reason, kept separate from any calculated delta.

source_pages.description: Page or section reference, e.g. '12-14'. Empty only when the source has no page numbers.
